en: Black‑and‑white view of a cobblestoned intersection in a European town, showing two and three‑story houses with tiled roofs and shopfronts. A broad square or junction opens in the foreground, with a long, gently rising street lined by similar buildings receding into the distance. People in early‑20th‑century clothing walk or stand along the street; a handcart or small wagon is visible. German‑language shop signs can be seen on the facades.
